semantic.justification: Task202610231627-0F8SYR: Writer import API attachment uses canonical document/nodes/registered positions/items rather than a separate document representation. Property descriptors, independent copies and unknown-name failure. Only the current canonical Writer core slice is represented. Full UNO service metadata/query interfaces, listeners, interactive undo/actions, Unicode cursor navigation, layout, unsupported character/table/conditional styles, ranges in unsupported sections, expanded bookmarks and wider properties remain unverified or unported. DomainMapper, OOXML package parser and export are outside this task; no whole-module parity claim. Native SfxItemPropertyMapEntry schema values and PropertyMoreFlags retain actual OUString/Type owners, source widths/checked preconditions, copy/assignment and reverse member destruction. SfxItemPropertyMap now uses actual sorted_vector/OUString comparison, borrowed immutable schema pointers, first duplicate insertion, counted UTF16 lower_bound and real cached Sequence<Property> values. Actual generated Property/UNO data assignment and sequence COW preserve cache sharing, independent returned descriptors and UnknownPropertyException defaults. Older SfxItemPropertySetInfo array projection remains explicitly unregistered/incomplete, not a native XPropertySetInfo provider. Full SfxItemPropertySet/property-info/static-map owner migration, SwXTextDefaults/application and DOCX/XLSX filters/export/UI remain incomplete; no broad default/service/ABI/parity promotion.
